title: Balance_getTransactionHistoryApi_Response_200
description: Response containing transaction history details for a specific balance and contact.

balanceDefinitionId.description: Unique identifier of the associated balance definition.

contactId.description: Unique identifier of the contact related to the transactions.

count.description: Total number of transactions in the history.

loyaltyProgramId.description: Unique identifier of the associated loyalty program.

transactionHistory.description: List of past transactions associated with the balance.

balanceExpirationDate.description: Expiration date of the balance associated with this transaction.

cancelledAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was canceled, if applicable.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was successfully completed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was initiated.

meta.description: Optional metadata associated with the transaction.

rejectReason.description: Reason for rejection, if the transaction was declined.

rejectedAt.description: Timestamp when the transaction was rejected.

status.description: Current status of the transaction (e.g., pending, completed, rejected).

LoyaltyBalanceProgramsPidTransactionHist.description: Represents a record of a past transaction, including status and key timestamps.
